title: Topic 2.3: Preservation of Cereals and Pulses

pages.lesson:
LESSON: PRESERVATION OF CEREALS AND PULSES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.3: Preservation of Cereals and Pulses

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Preservation of Cereals and Pulses
2. Practise Preservation of Cereals and Pulses at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Preservation of Cereals and Pulses
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Preservation of Cereals and Pulses. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Preservation of Cereals and Pulses at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Preservation of Cereals and Pulses at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses in the examples.
2. Explain Preservation of Cereals and Pulses to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Preservation of Cereals and Pulses important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Preservation of Cereals and Pulses
2. Practise Preservation of Cereals and Pulses at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
